facts.rationale: Preserves overlay details while separating first-cut transition from manual scene dismissal and cross-file continuation.
facts.value: Entry initializes a 30-update input lockout, first-overlay counter 0x320, disabled captures with zero selectors, second-overlay alpha zero, and divider seven. Once enabled, the first overlay rebuilds each process invocation and decays toward zero; the second rebuilds every eighth enabled invocation, adds ten alpha up to 0xBE, and uses RGB AA/AA/FF. Each rebuild toggles its selector. After advancing the first-cut camera, exact curr_frame == end_frame triggers ordered first-phase cleanup, frees four gm_80480964 image allocations, invokes gm_801A7B00 to construct cut 2, and requests destruction of the completed camera. This is not whole-scene exit. Subsequent camera phases live in other units. Independently, newly triggered Start after the lockout performs audio feedback and requests scene-runner exit; the update that decrements the timer to zero still ignores input.
